finalText:
I rebooked all 13 passengers from the cancelled AA918, issued the vouchers they're owed and sent each of them one message with their new itinerary. Nobody was charged a change fee or fare difference.

**How I ordered them:** Seats were short, so I booked passengers by frequent-flyer tier (platinum, gold, silver, none), then by earliest booking date. The two passengers travelling together (R6110 and R6111) were treated as one booking at the priority of their gold member. AA918 was scheduled to reach ORD at 13:40 on 3 Aug, with Boston passengers connecting to arrive at 18:55.

| Res | Passenger (tier) | New itinerary | Cabin | Owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park (platinum) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15–12:25 | Business | Nothing (arrives early) |
| R6109 | Iris Vance (platinum) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15–12:25 | **Premium economy, up from economy** (economy was full on UA88) | Nothing |
| R6110 / R6111 | Jun Takeda / Kofi Mensah (group) | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05–15:15, together | Economy | Nothing (1h35 late) |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor (gold) | DL512, 3 Aug, 12:30–18:40 | Economy | $150 compensation (5h late) |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad (gold) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15–12:25 | Basic economy | Nothing |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen (gold) | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | **Business, up from premium economy** (premium economy full on earlier flights) | Nothing |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta (silver), to Boston | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40–23:50, then AA1410 ORD–BOS, 4 Aug, 09:00–12:25 | Economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah (silver), to Boston | Same as Dev Mehta | Economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt (silver) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40–23:50 | Economy | $300 compensation (10h10 late) |
| R6107 | Grace Liu (none) | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | Economy | **$240 compensation** (the $300 band, capped at her $240 fare) + $180 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz (none) | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | Economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6105 | Elena Fox (none) | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | Basic economy | Nothing |

- **Upgrades:** Only two people were moved up a cabin. Both are gold or platinum, travelling alone on a single flight, and their own cabin was full on a flight that arrives sooner. Ben Okafor qualified on the same terms, but there were no premium economy seats left on UA88 or AA204, so he stays in economy on DL512.
- **Boston connections:** Dev Mehta and Mo Farah could no longer make the 15:30 AA1402 to Boston. I rebooked that leg as well, onto the next-morning AA1410.

**Date mismatch:** The task context gave today's date as 2026-10-06, but the reservation system reports 2026-08-02, the day before the cancelled flight. I followed the system date, which puts all the replacement flights in the future, including UA88 at 06:15 on 3 Aug. There were no operational bulletins in effect, so the standard rules applied.
